'''Darima Kedari''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] who served as the [[Chancellor (Klatooinian)|Chancellor]] of the Klatooinian [[Council of Elders (Klatooinian)|Council of Elders]]. During his early life, he was a [[Gambling/Legends|gambler]], and he came into contact with [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], although he eventually turned away from his gambling ways. In [[44 ABY]], he was met with crisis when a group of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Violation|attacked]] the sacred [[Fountain of Ancients|Fountain of the Ancients]]. With the arrival of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]], who were bound by [[Treaty of Vontor|treaty]] to protect the Fountain, the Sith were stopped. Darima then asked Calrissian and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]], who had just arrived in-[[Star system/Legends|system]], to mediate the situation. After hearing from all sides, Solo and Calrissian found the Sith under the command of [[Vyn Holpur]] guilty of attacking and damaging the Fountain&mdash;resulting in an execution sentence for Holpur and his crew&mdash;and that the Hutts had ineffectively protected the Fountain. However, they also decided that the Hutts had not violated the treaty, as, with the damage they had sustained during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], there was no way they would have been able to stop the sudden attack, and they had acted as effectively as they could. Despite this ruling, Klatooinians across the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] began to [[Liberation|revolt]] against the Hutts, and Kedari realized that any hopes of peace were gone.
